syntactic_simplification:
Mice are important in neuroscience research. Scientists use mice to study the brain. Mice are a good model for this research. 

Researchers often use male mice in experiments. They do this because of the hormone cycle in female mice. The hormone cycle can cause different behaviors. This may change the results of experiments.
lexical_simplification:
Mice are important in brain research. Scientists use mice to study the brain. Mice are a good example for this research.

Researchers often use male mice in tests. They do this because of the hormone cycle in female mice. The hormone cycle can cause different behaviors. This may change the results of tests.
paraphrase_or_explanation:
Mice are important in studying the brain. Scientists use mice to learn more about how the brain works. Mice are a good example for this kind of research.

Researchers often use male mice in tests. They do this because female mice have a hormone cycle. A hormone cycle is a regular change in the body that can affect how a female behaves. Different behaviors can make it hard to get clear results in tests.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text:
Mice are important in studying the brain. Scientists use mice to learn how the brain works. Mice are a good example for this research.

Researchers usually test male mice. They do this because female mice have a hormone cycle. A hormone cycle is when the body changes regularly and can change how a female behaves. Different behaviors can make it hard to get clear results in tests.
